skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: The Law
skins.content: Test Collection Series/The Law. The jailer garments Saria used when entering Mansfield State Prison, largely in line with the female jailer's standard uniform.
skins.quote: Submission is order. Order is justice.

skins.name: Stronghold
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Stronghold. An outfit worn by Saria during the confrontation between the General Jurisdiction and the Research Branch. Though her surroundings crumbled under the onslaught of Arts colliding, her conviction never wavered, like the land itself.
skins.usage: One of Saria's outfits for crucial moments.
skins.quote: 'What's the matter, Boss? You don't seem as sharp as before. Since you didn't manage to finish me off, I suppose it's my turn now. Don't blink.'
